after.action: Use instant scrolling for keyboard Back to Top activation independently of motion preference
after.evidence: TASK_005 recorded 120 primary trusted-input activations, four rapid Enter bursts and four programmatic checks. Enter and Space reached zero synchronously in the isolated candidate; pointer activation retained smooth scrolling under both motion preferences. Technical verification passed with documented focus-loss, narrow-width overflow and Chromium-only limitations. The final owner-delegated decision rejects this implementation alternative and prefers original smooth Back to Top scrolling.

after.ownerDecision: R-029 was rejected after technical review and owner-delegated evaluation. The keyboard-only instant-scroll alternative showed measurable timing improvement but insufficient practical UX benefit to justify changing the existing consistent smooth-scroll behavior and adding input-classification logic. Existing focus-loss behavior remains a separate limitation. Original Back to Top scrolling is preferred.
